fieldNotes.facility: Niagara Bottling Imperial PA, 201 Solar Dr, Findlay Industrial Park near Pittsburgh International Airport. ~$64M plant. Confirmed via web search and Street View: building with blue Niagara branding and bulk water silos.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. Street View (2025-05) at the entrance shows the driveway running straight from the public road into the property with only directional signs and a speed-limit sign - no barrier arm, no sliding gate, no guard booth at the road or along the approach.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at the entrance or along the truck route. A small structure near the perimeter-road/dock-yard junction is not a clear staffed booth; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock face along the E/NE side with trailers backed in plus a full drop row; estimate ~65 doors, 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Heavy trailer drop yard along the E face with multiple rows of parked trailers without tractors; firmly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows in the E dock yard, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck route / apron inside the property before the dock doors provides queue/holding space.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Findlay Industrial Park near Pittsburgh airport sits in a hilly, partly wooded area away from dense metro fabric; judged Rural per the small-town-industrial tiebreak.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~445m N-S x ~340m E-W); ~50 acres.
